Company Description
To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members!

Job Description
We’re looking for a Senior Video & Streaming Engineer to join CD PROJEKT RED’s Live Video team in Warsaw.
In this role, you will support the creation of high-quality video content promoting our games, the studio, teams, events, and representatives. You will be involved in studio operations, live streaming, virtual production, green screen workflows, asset management and post-production, helping us deliver professional video materials for both internal and external needs.
You will be responsible for maintaining and operating studio equipment, supporting recordings and live productions, maintaining reliable technical workflows, assisting with post-production tasks such as color grading, keying, tracking, final asset delivery, and introducing new solutions that improve the way we produce, stream, capture, and finish video content.
Responsibilities:

• Setting up, maintaining, and improving video production systems, camera workflows, and streaming pipelines.
• Operating broadcast systems, including camera switching and stream management.
• Ensuring stable technical workflows for live production, recording, and streaming environments.
• Working with cameras, broadcast tools, virtual production setups, green screen workflows, and related technologies.
• Supporting post-production tasks such as color grading, keying, tracking, final asset delivery and archiving.
• Supporting the implementation of new technologies that improve quality, reliability, and efficiency in virtual production and live streaming.
• Troubleshooting technical issues related to video equipment, recording systems, streaming setups, and post-production workflows.
• Staying up to date with new technologies connected to filming, streaming, virtual production, and video finishing.

Qualifications
• At least 5 years of experience in video production, video technology, broadcast, streaming, or a similar field.
• Excellent knowledge of broadcast and streaming systems, including tools such as OBS and Blackmagic ATEM.
• Practical experience working with professional camera systems, including Blackmagic, Sony, or RED cameras.
• Working knowledge of Unreal Engine in the context of virtual production.
• Experience with green screen workflows, including setup, recording, and keying.
• Good understanding of how a professional film set and broadcast studio works.
• Readiness to learn and implement new technologies related to filming, streaming, virtual production, and video workflows.
• Basic knowledge of macOS.
• Great command of English.
Nice to have

• Experience with editing or finishing software such as DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro.
• Ability to record audio using dedicated audio recorders.
• Ability to make quick decisions in production or live-event environments.
• Interest in games, game development, and visual storytelling.
Candidates are kindly requested to provide portfolio/examples of the projects they did.

Additional Information
Work mode: office-first from the Warsaw office.
Health & Well-Being

• Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
• Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
• Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
• Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives.
• Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
• Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain.
• RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events.
• RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company.
Perks & Professional Growth

• A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
• Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
• REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.
• Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!
Social Activities & Life in the Office

• Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
• Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
• Healthy selections — ​​canteens.
• Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
• Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog.
• A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.
• An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes.
• No dress-code — we like to keep it casual.
Estimated pay range for this position: 14 800 – 20 400 PLN gross monthly.…
